rows.en: Yes. As the name says, it is a Devil Gundam control part that makes use of a living being!
A Life Core must have an extraordinarily tough body and great skill as a fighter!!
But such individuals are not easily found.
And so I held a martial arts tournament in the Ultra Cube!!
What!? Then that tournament was held to find a Life Core!!
...I see. So that tournament was held to find a Life Core!
...I see. So that tournament was held to find a Life Core!
What!? That tournament was held to find a Life Core!!
What!? Then that tournament was held to find a Life Core!!
What? Then you're saying that tournament was held to find a Life Core!?
...Then that tournament was held to find a Life Core!?
What!? That tournament was held to find a Life Core!!
What!? That tournament was held to find a Life Core!!
What? Then that tournament was... held to find a Life Core!?
...So that means that tournament was held to find a Life Core!?
Hey! Hold on a sec! That whole tournament was for this monster!?
What!? Then that tournament was... held to find a Life Core!!
What!? Then that tournament was... held to find a Life Core!!
What? That tournament was held to find a Life Core!?
And at last!! I came upon the one with the greatest aptitude of all...
...and I succeeded in having him absorbed into the Devil Gundaaaaam!!!
So that guy got absorbed into it...!!
Fuhahaha!! Exactly!! Now, go forth! Devil Gundam!!!
Fuhahahahahahahaha...!! Fools!! Before the Devil Gundam, the likes of you are no better than babes!!
Taking in Zamsha was the right call, it seems. Very well, then it's time we settled this...
Are you ready, hero rabble!! With my power and the Devil Gundam's, I'll finish you!!
Master Gundam!! You're going to tell us!! Where is this Cube's power source!?
Master Gundam!! Where is this Cube's power source!?
Master Gundam!! Where is this Cube's power source!?
Master Gundam!! Where is this Cube's power source!?
Master Gundam!! Where is this Cube's power source!?

notes.note: Leader blocks in 0642 use the chain 8,9,10,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1 = God, Wing Zero, 00, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1 (as in story_122). #0.41-55, #0.78-92, #0.98-112 and #0.119-133 are k=0..14 of that chain.
Life Core = glossary term for the Devil Gundam's living host; 'as the name suggests' kept since 'Life' carries the living-being sense.
Ultra Cube per glossary; the tournament is the Regis Fight held there.

#0.60-73 are 14 leader variants labelled Rider 1 by the extractor (constant name carry-over). Voicing matches the chain minus God Gundam: WZ, 00, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Momotaros (#0.71, rough 'this monster' line), RX, Rider 1. Identical JP -> identical EN.
Ankh's version of the same reaction; script shows it in the branch apart from the 14 variants, most likely when God Gundam leads (God has no variant in #0.60-73). Inferred.
'Him' = Zamsha (g=m), revealed in #0.77-78; Master Gundam knows who it is. Elongated final syllable kept as 'Gundaaaaam'.
Ankh: 'aitsu' = Zamsha; 'into it' = the Devil Gundam.
Pain-cry block, k order God..Rider 1. 'Ngh...!!' for kutsu matches earlier slices; RX and Rider 1 share identical JP.
'Heroes-domo' rendered 'hero rabble', echoing 'You Lost Hero rabble' in story_122.
God Gundam (Domon) demands of his master; 'oshiete moraou' -> 'You're going to tell us'. Demand ending with full-width !! rendered '!?' as a question.
Wing Zero variant reads 'doko da nan da', apparently a script typo for 'doko nan da'; translated as the plain question.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped from 0642.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain; #0.60-73 mislabelled Rider 1 (14 variants minus God), #0.74 Ankh likely the God-leader branch (inferred). #0.120 source typo. No new names or terms.
